summary: 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition for approval for the creation of security interest over the Petitioner’s assets, including all movable and immovable assets, in favour of Respondent No.3, Catalyst Trusteeship Limited (“Catalyst”/ “Security Trustee”) and for the benefit of Respondent No.2, REC Limited (“REC”/ “Lender”) including its successors, transferees, novatees, and assigns for a sum of Rs. 3,971.35 crore. The Petitioner has made the following prayers: _(b) Approve the creation of the Security Interest by way of hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ assignment (as applicable), over all the movable and immovable assets, Transmission Project accounts, Project Documents (including assignment of transmission licence) etc., both present and future, of the Petitioner in terms of the Financing Documents, or as may be agreed between the Petitioner and the Lender from time to time, in favour of Lender / Security Trustee to secure the financial assistance availed/ to be availed from the Lender and its subsequent transferees, assigns, novates and substitutes thereof and any refinancing lenders to the Project, by executing deed of hypothecation and power of attorney in relation thereto, Indenture of Mortgage, Mortgage by deposit of title deeds and such other security documents as per law or as may be required by the Lender from time to time through which a charge can be created._ _(c) Pass any or such further orders as may be deemed fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.”_ 4. The Petitioner has submitted that pursuant to the terms of the Loan Agreement (Clause 3.1), the Petitioner is required to create the necessary security interest in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, for the benefit of the lender, REC Limited, _inter alia,_ as follows: _“a. a first ranking charge by way of mortgage of all the immovable properties, present and future, of the Petitioner (including the Project Site);_ _c. a first ranking charge by way of hypothecation over all accounts of the Petitioner, including, the Trust and Retention Account and the sub-account(s) (upon opening of such accounts as per the timelines set out under Loan Agreement), or any account created for any reserve(s) to be created and maintained (or any account in substitution thereof) that may be opened in accordance with the Trust and Retention Account Agreement and the Financing Documents, or any of the other Project Documents and all funds from time to time deposited therein, the receivables and all Permitted Investments or other securities representing all amounts credited to the Trust and Retention Account, any letter of credit and other reserves of the Borrower present and future wherever maintained;_ _d. a first ranking charge, by way of assignment over all rights, title, interest, benefits, claims and demand whatsoever of the Petitioner in:_ - _ii. the Clearances (including the tie-ups, approvals, permissions, right of way (RoW), each in relation to the Project);_ 5. The Petitioner has submitted that, as per Article 15 of the TSA dated 19.11.2024, it is entitled to create any encumbrance over all or part of the receivables or the Transmission Project Assets in favour of the lender(s) or lenders’ representative (as defined in the TSA) as security for amounts payable under the Financing Agreements. Therefore, the Petitioner has submitted that the Petitioner has the full right to create a security interest and charge in favour of Catalyst Trusteeship Limited for the benefit of the lender subject to conditions prescribed under Article 15 of the TSA. 7. Accordingly, the Petitioner has filed the present Petition under Sections 17(3) and 17(4) of the Act seeking prior approval of the Commission for the creation of a Security Interest over the assets including the movable and immovable assets for the Project in favour of the Security Trustee for the benefit of the lender and for its subsequent transferees, assignees, novatees thereof by way of hypothecation/ 8. The Petitioner has also relied on the Commission’s order dated 14.8.2025 in _Petition No. 586/MP/2025,_ wherein the Commission allowed a similar Petition under Section 17(3) and Section 17(4) of the Act, wherein the Petitioner therein was granted in-principle approval and was allowed to create a security interest over the assets of the Transmission Project. 9. The Petition was called out for the hearing on 26.2.2026 after notice to the Respondents. _Vide_ Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) for the hearing dated 26.2.2026, the Respondents were granted the opportunity to file their respective replies. 10. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that no reply has been filed by the Respondents despite notice. Upon consideration of the Petitioner's submissions, the matter was reserved for order. 11. We have considered the submissions made by the Petitioner and perused the documents placed on record. The Petitioner approached the lender, REC Limited, for financing the Petitioner’s Project and availed a Rupee Term Loan amounting to Rs.3,971.35 crore as per the terms and conditions stipulated in the Loan Agreement with REC Limited on 30.9.2025. Further, the Petitioner, Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, and REC Limited entered into a Tripartite Security Trustee Agreement dated 30.9.2025 _“17. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part hereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._
